name: Does the path pay? Forward excursion, and the ceiling on timing detection
_note: Every [Cooper] value below is UNFILLED BY DESIGN. The agent proposes none of them and fills none of them. T1 hard-stops (escalation row 2) if any remain unfilled in the committed file.

cost._source: results/reports/phase_11_report.md - named cell, RTH, latency 5 min. NOT recomputed here.
cost.reporting_rule: D19 - both units always, neither alone
cost.standing_qualifier_verbatim: Effective spread measures the cost of the average print, not the cost of a specific order. Depth, queue position and fill probability are not measured. The cost stack is a LOWER BOUND.

arm1._description: Excursion base rate. Zero passes over filtered_trades / filtered_quotes.
arm1.latency_0_note: Physical impossibility. Labelled the upper bound on every chart and table. D7.
arm1.latency_axis_caveat: Minute resolution cannot express a 1-3 second execution lag, so Arm 1's latency axis is PESSIMISTIC relative to achievable execution. State this in the report. Arm 2 carries the real axis.

entry_denominators.event_equalised: seeded uniform subsample of entries_per_event bars per event, equal weight per event
entry_denominators.rule: Both carried. Never blended. Phase 11 T7b pattern.

arm1.smin_note: The one surviving criterion of the 10-series. Enters here as a STRATIFIER only. No field is computed in Arm 1.

arm2._description: Oracle ceiling. Non-causal by construction and that is the point. Gated behind T4.
arm2.authorisation_note: Set true ONLY by Cooper in writing after the T4 gate. The agent does not set this.
arm2.arm2_cohort_artifact: [Cooper] - repo path to the committed cohort manifest the causal run produced
arm2.arm2_cohort_expected_n: [Cooper] - the row count of that artifact, asserted at load
arm2.arm2_cohort_note: The cohort is a NAMED FROZEN ARTIFACT, not a count. Row 5 fires if the loaded manifest's row count differs from arm2_cohort_expected_n in EITHER direction - silent expansion and silent reduction are the same defect. The centred +60s admissible set (n=75) and the causal cohort (n=78) are different sets, possibly not nested; do not substitute one for the other, and do not reconstruct either from a count.
arm2.collapse_note: Precondition, not a detail. Real tape carries same-timestamp prints (log 0).

signal.amended: 2026-08-30 under D23 - the original LEVEL-only instruction is withdrawn
signal.level_definition: lambda_hat(t,s) above its own trailing q90
signal.null_rate_matching: REQUIRED before any cross-channel onset comparison. T5b-i, escalation row 23.
signal.null_rate_matching_why: An onset is a first-passage event. First passage of a noisier series occurs EARLIER with no information content. D22 measured FIELD firing at 2.8x the LEVEL rate. Until thresholds are matched on burst-free tape, "FIELD leads" and "FIELD is noisier" are the same statement.

channels_closed_do_not_build.D: m + lograte/ln10 + gamma/ln10 - degenerate against the Poisson reference. Fired its kill condition again under the CAUSAL kernel: 3 and 2 onsets over 78 events. Remains closed.

arm2.control_matching: stratified on seconds_since_anchor so the control shares the oracle's position-in-path distribution
arm2.control_note: Intraday drift is real and large. An unmatched control measures drift, not selection.
arm2.smin_causal_note: A one-sided kernel keeps half the mass, so n_eff = sqrt(pi)*s*lam and the causal floor is exactly TWICE the centred one. Using 2.26/lam under a causal kernel puts every read at n_eff = 4.00. Escalation row 24. Implemented as scale_field.s_min_onesided / s_min_for_rate(kernel='onesided').
arm2.field_status_note: D22 closed FIELD as a detector on two facts. Fact 1 (saturation, dL/dln s >= -1) is UNCHANGED and survives the causal kernel - dw/dln s = w*z^2 regardless of support. Fact 2 (FIELD lags LEVEL) was REVERSED by D23 under a one-sided kernel. Only fact 2 is reopened.

barrier_grid.expiry: the horizon H of the cell
barrier_grid.breakeven_note: Arithmetic, not a choice. One round trip is charged on every outcome. Do NOT assume 0.5.
barrier_grid.expiry_in_dollars_note: model_selection_session_notes s6 prefers a dollar expiry over a clock expiry. NOT adopted here - Arm 1 is bar-based and has no dollar clock. Logged as an open item for the feature phase.

reading_rules.R1_intrabar_ordering: Compute BOTH bounds (optimistic / pessimistic). Never a single Arm 1 first-passage number. Report ambiguous share.
reading_rules.R2_expiry_class: Three outcome classes sum to 1 per cell. A win rate on touched-only entries is a BANNED output.
reading_rules.R3_no_fill: Own row, own share. Never dropped, never forward-filled.
reading_rules.R4_dead_tape: Entries with MFE and MAE both below the smallest barrier at every horizon - own share per cell.
reading_rules.R5_event_dominance: Every pooled cell reports raw n, distinct events, and effective n under event-equal weighting.
reading_rules.R6_breakeven: p_clear reported against p_breakeven per cell, always.
reading_rules.R7_thin_cells: Cells below min_cell_n hatched, carry no claim, appear in no summary sentence.

named_cell._description: The single cell escalation rows 10, 11 and 12 are evaluated on. Chosen before the run.
named_cell.cell_rationale: latency 5 / hold 30 / RTH matches the Phase 11 named cell exactly, so the two phases are directly comparable. The barrier pair is Cooper's.

cooper_thresholds._note: UNFILLED. Escalation row 2 hard-stops T1 if any remain [Cooper] in the committed file.
cooper_thresholds.row_10_scope: R1 ambiguous share on the named cell. Above this, Arm 1 cannot carry a first-passage conclusion; MFE/MAE distributions still stand.
cooper_thresholds.row_11_scope: R3 no-fill share on the named cell.
cooper_thresholds.row_12_proposal: pessimistic p_clear below p_breakeven at EVERY cell in the grid
cooper_thresholds.row_12_scope: THE ARM 1 GATE. Firing means the path does not pay at minute scale. Arm 2 does not run.
cooper_thresholds.row_12_reasoning: Expressed as a SHARE against an arithmetic break-even, defined on every candidate entry. Phase 11's row 11 was a median ratio and could not see a denominator that was non-positive on 52.86% of its cell. This is the direct correction.
cooper_thresholds.row_13_proposal: lower bound of the event-clustered CI on p_clear(oracle) - p_clear(control) <= 0 at the best cell
cooper_thresholds.row_13_scope: THE CEILING. Firing means an oracle with full lookahead does not beat random entry inside the same event, and the timing-detector line closes.
cooper_thresholds.row_13_reasoning: Non-causality only helps the oracle, so a null here is decisive in a way a null on a causal detector would not be.
cooper_thresholds.row_1_amendment: AMENDED 2026-08-31 by Cooper. The original row 1 stopped on 'phase-11-approved absent OR master moved since it'. master being ahead is the expected state - the scale-space arc happened after Phase 11 and touched nothing this phase consumes - and clearing the row by fiat would have thrown away the check it was meant to make. Split into: row 1 (tag absent -> stop), row 1a (any of the five frozen inputs differs in content hash from its state at the tag -> stop, post both hashes and the commits that touched it), row 1b (master moved AND 1a passes -> NOT a stop; record the commit count in decisions_log and proceed). An unconditional branch check replaced by a real integrity test.

runtime_ceilings.on_breach: hard stop; do not silently reduce the cohort, the grid, or the ladder

closed_do_not_reopen: D9 interval-based, no intensity curve as operating variable
D21 threshold-from-trough and every repair inside it, including exact partition
burst vs quiet as a split
any free parameter referenced to a Poisson null
write_allowlist: docs/Universe-Decisions.md (APPEND-ONLY, number confirmed by reading the file)

reporting.n_rule: Every posted table carries n AND effective n per row. Every prose claim carries its chart filename.
reporting.description_only: No recommendations, no causal language, no 'suggests / confirms / indicates / therefore'.
reporting.escalation_report_order: Report in table order - the table is the priority order.
reporting.units_rule: D19 - bp and cents, never one alone
